evidence.reason: reviewOk now requires initialBlocking to be either null or an array before calling .every(fingerprintOk), so a review row with a missing or non-array initialBlocking fails the shape check and becomes a corrupt unknown entry via admit instead of throwing a TypeError and aborting computeOutcomePanels.
